admission.justification: A public page must describe the product, not the coordination that produced it; a leaked identifier names an object the reader cannot open, while a product-shown name must stand on a marked line so the exemption is visible.

applicability: Every public document, on every page.
conditions: No identifier of a task, a leaf, a requirement packet or a decision appears on any page, unless a marker on its line allows it.
A name of that shape that the product itself shows stands only on a line that carries the marker.
exclusions: Internal memory, task records and coordination documents outside the public documentation.
statement: No public document holds an identifier of a task, a leaf, a requirement packet or a decision, on any page. A name of that shape that the product itself shows stands only on a line that carries the marker.
